text: I'm really scared, sorry. I've got my nephew, he's 15 months, and his temp was 39.7 earlier which seems really high to me? I gave him calpol and when it kicks in he's honestly fine, toddling about playing with his blocks and chattering away and drinking his milk. Then it creeps back up. He was sick once earlier this evening but he's kept all his drinks down since then I think, nothing else has come back up. I don't know if 39.7 is dangerous for a baby that age or if I'm just panicking because he's not mine and I'm terrified something happens on my watch
